modes.bull: Debt fundraising allows the company to secure capital for operations or expansion without diluting existing equity.

summary: Torrent Power Limited announced the allotment of 2,00,000 non-convertible debentures (NCDs) on a private placement basis. The decision was approved during the company's meeting held on November 26, 2026. headline: Torrent Power acquires 100% stake in Torrent Urja 42
hook: Full control of Torrent Urja 42 acquired

modes.bear: The acquisition cost and potential debt assumption for the subsidiary could weigh on the parent company's balance sheet in the short term.
modes.bull: Full ownership allows Torrent Power to streamline operations and capture 100% of the subsidiary's future earnings and project cash flows.
modes.simple: Torrent Power has bought all shares of Torrent Urja 42, making it a fully owned part of the company to better manage its power projects.

summary: Torrent Power Limited has officially informed the National Stock Exchange about its acquisition of a 100% equity stake in Torrent Urja 42 Private Limited. This transaction makes the entity a wholly-owned subsidiary of the power major. The filing confirms the completion of the share purchase, though specific financial details of the deal were not disclosed in the brief announcement. This move aligns with the company's strategy to consolidate its various power project vehicles.
why_it_matters: Full ownership of subsidiary strengthens Torrent's project execution control.
